forum.title: STM32G070CBT6 0.7V on input pin PD0 with external 10k pullup.
forum.best_answer_content: I used deactive dead battery pull-up. Thanks for help.
forum.content_text:
Hello i use STM32G070CBT6 with PD0 and others pins.

PD0 as input pin with no internal pull-up/down with extrenal 10k pullup gives only 0.7V, when i set the pin to output and set state to high there is 3.3V.

Where is the problem?
forum.author: transistor

scraped_replies.html: What else is PD0 connected to externally? Show your schematic. Likely something externally is pulling it down. Enable the internal pullup/pulldown to quantify the change in the output level.
scraped_replies.author: TDK

scraped_replies.html: PD1 and PD2 are connected in the same way and they work right.
scraped_replies.author: transistor

scraped_replies.html: PD0 is one of UCPD pins. Either connect PD1 to GND or disable the default operation in software. The topic was discussed many times.
scraped_replies.author: gbm

scraped_replies.html:
